research_question: Does an irregular-time-aware JEPA representation improve held-out transient ranking/classification relative to a time-agnostic JEPA and simple photometric baselines under an object-disjoint frozen evaluation?

candidate_dataset.name: Unblinded Data for PLAsTiCC Classification Challenge

source_evidence.record_reference: PLASTICC Team, The PLASTICC Data Set, arXiv:1810.00001

preoutcome_split_intent.development: PLAsTiCC published training surface only, subject to an exact object-disjoint internal train/validation manifest frozen before model comparison.
preoutcome_split_intent.candidate_confirmatory: PLAsTiCC published test surface only if independent review establishes that its now-public unblinded labels have not entered method/threshold development and an outcome-blind loader can enforce label isolation.
preoutcome_split_intent.fallback_if_confirmatory_freshness_fails: If confirmatory freshness fails, treat PLAsTiCC as development/external-characterization only and select a separate genuinely unobserved astronomy benchmark before making confirmatory claims.

frozen_decision_policy_if_candidate_is_a.primary_metric_definition: For each represented class, compute mean negative log probability assigned to the true class across confirmatory objects in that class after row-wise probability renormalization and clipping each normalized probability to [1e-15, 1-1e-15]; then take the unweighted mean of the class means.
frozen_decision_policy_if_candidate_is_a.effect_definition: delta = loss_time_agnostic_jepa - loss_time_aware_jepa; positive favors time-aware JEPA

uncertainty.resampling_unit: resample model seeds with replacement; within each selected seed, resample confirmatory objects with replacement separately inside each true class; recompute the class-balanced paired delta

frozen_decision_policy_if_candidate_is_a.primary_failure_rule: If any primary success condition fails, the primary result is not positive; no secondary metric or named transient can rescue it.
frozen_decision_policy_if_candidate_is_a.multiple_comparison_policy: Only the time-aware versus time-agnostic JEPA comparison is confirmatory. Persistence and robust-deviation baselines are contextual/descriptive and cannot substitute for the primary comparison.

applicable licensing/usage terms recorded from an authoritative source
exact downloaded byte receipts and local SHA-256 identities for every approved dataset file
exact object-level internal train/validation manifest for development-only fitting and tuning
exact representation-to-class-probability readout architecture and fitting rule frozen before heldout access
outcome-blind heldout parser proving labels/classes are inaccessible during feature/model/readout fitting and threshold selection
exact code commit, dependency environment, and hardware/runtime identity
independent approval receipt that cannot be self-issued by the execution script
required_independent_review_before_any_h: confirm the Zenodo v1 record and every retained file checksum against the live official record
record applicable licensing/usage terms; the observed Zenodo record does not display a license value
determine whether public unblinding or prior team exposure makes the original PLAsTiCC test labels unsuitable for confirmatory use
review the exact parser so heldout labels/classes are inaccessible to feature fitting, model fitting, early stopping, threshold selection, architecture selection, and hyperparameter search
freeze exact object/split identities and byte receipts after download without inspecting heldout outcome summaries
confirm the frozen decision policy, probability readout, uncertainty procedure, seeds, and practical-effect threshold before model outcomes
confirm that a simulated PLAsTiCC result will be described as simulated-benchmark evidence rather than real-sky clinical/operational validation
claim_boundary: This artifact selects a provenance-pinned candidate and freezes its confirmatory decision policy for the Space-JEPA astronomy track; it is not a dataset freeze, not proof of freshness, not execution authorization, and not an astronomy result. A positive PLAsTiCC result would support only a simulated transient-classification claim unless separately confirmed on real observations.
